examples.text: Edna also said to Tobias, The Lord of heaven restore thee, my dear brother, and grant that I may see thy children of my daughter Sara before I die.
examples.ref: 1611, The Holy Bible, […] (King James Version), London: […] Robert Barker, […], →OCLC, Tobit 10:12:

examples.text: 'Edna', forsooth! No doubt her origin and morals are quite as apocryphal as her name.
examples.ref: 1866, Augusta Jane Evans, St. Elmo, G. W. Dillingham, page 54:

examples.text: Conjure faces to go with these names: Edna and Joy. Then I'll tell you that Edna, who has a wicked serve, is our team beauty, and Joy is as plain and dour as they come.

categories: English female given names from Hebrew
